q: Combat zones hold 2 tiers each (C1 Graveyard + Crypt, C2 Spider Den + Slime Bog ... C5 Wither Keep + Citadel)?
w: Halves the builds and fills each zone with people. The two built arenas join into C1.

q: Mine zones hold 3/3/2/2/2 tiers and Forest zones 3/3/2/2/1 tiers?
w: Early tiers go fast, so they share zones; late tiers are long, so fewer per zone.

q: One dungeon boss hall after combat zone 5, plus one world boss arena for the big bosses?
w: That is how I read "+1 on dungeon for boss" and "main boss area".

q: One gate per zone (15 instead of 33), opening at the zone's first tier level. Higher tiers inside unlock by skill level with no gate?
w: Fewer walls, less walking. The upgrade happens around you.

q: When you unlock a tier, your blocks change in place with a big moment (particle wave, sound, title "Iron unlocked!"). In combat it waits until you are 5 s out of a fight. No extra "Switch now" button?
w: This is the most fun moment of the Depths, so make it feel great and keep it automatic. Lower tiers are picked in /dungeon when you need old materials.

q: Layered mobs (each player only sees their own tier's mobs) is the most advanced part: other players swing at nothing, friends must pick the same tier to fight together, and every mob ability (arrows, potions, roars) needs a filter. Use the simpler version instead: each combat zone has one area per tier (graveyard above, crypt below) and everyone sees the same mobs?
c: You picked (D3): layered mobs from the start
w: Same fun, easy to understand, far fewer bugs, and fights look alive because you see other people fight real mobs. The block trick (coal turns to iron) stays for mine and forest, where it is simple. No = keep layered mobs.

q: One setting in /settings: see Everyone / Friends + island / Nobody. No "pin a player" feature?
w: Less is more: three choices cover it. Pins add a button and rules nobody needs at launch.

q: You see other players (by your setting), but always your own blocks: a friend on iron looks like he mines your coal?
w: Normal phasing. A help hologram at each gate explains "everyone sees their own tier".

q: A short test first (2-3 days: the coal field and one combat zone, you test with Java + Bedrock) before the full build?
w: If Bedrock can't show it right, we find out in days, not weeks.

q: The boss hall opens after you have killed the zone 5 mini-boss once (no key needed)?
w: One clear goal, nothing to farm or trade.
